This conflicts with the existing animal-first curated order: bat belongs to the tools category. The contract is the first project after animal/template/game series, which is InfoSpace immediately after dreamro and before signoff-now. Corrected only this review script, reran the five affected order/navigation checks, and retained all 59 unaffected results. No application files changed.

sourceChangeNote: The shared Palette component and parent-owned InfoSpace adoption/provenance metadata changed between review passes. Affected palette/directory behavior was rechecked and final screenshots captured after adoption. The original/foreground artwork hashes and all six archived download sources remained unchanged.

observations: The indigo tray keeps the four original color families while making unequal compartments and the central adjustable divider visible in the large artwork.
Icon, checkerboard and white presentations render with consistent artwork proportions. Representative light/dark alpha views show no obvious rectangular matte, edge clipping or visible white fringe.

The 128/64 px tiles retain the compartment geometry. At 32/24/16 px the colored blocks and tray silhouette remain visible; fine paper grain and the adjustment-slot detail merge, consistent with the documented size note. Small specimens have transparent corners and no extra rounded mask.

At 320 px the goal and all seven technology badges wrap within the page. README links, controls, captions and download links remain visible. Clean captures avoid transient clipboard toasts and sticky-header overlap introduced by element-only screenshot capture.

The static disclosure contains the four references in the requested order: application screenshot, Signoff material study, ref01 board, ref02 detail. Reference boards are absent from the site gallery.
Final clear site captures show adopted status supplied by the parent metadata work. Original and foreground artwork SHA-256 values remained the same as the initial review snapshot.
